provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-01, Larry's son asking the four cold interview probes written the same day and typing Larry's answers as he spoke them. Nothing from the day's document research was supplied to him before he answered. Raw capture and analysis: research/interviews/2026-09-01-phone-answers.md.
text: They called the camp The Mountain. The guys in my Unit in Saigon called it the mountain.
researchNotes: Answer to a probe about what the place was called. Beyond the name itself, it confirms in passing that the Saigon end of the net was his own unit — which bears on the flight-following question (ledger #2, issue #57) and on his description elsewhere of being "the only annex" of Saigon center.
